ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white/light-gray) to low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels, approximately 85:15 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous region across the central area of both lobes. Low-intensity dark pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edge and distal tips. Multiple small, isolated dark focal spots (mottling) distributed sparsely across the central white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a sharp interior pixel angle and significant vertical bounding-box depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern characterized by jagged peaks and deep valleys along the entire continuous trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude of serrations is greater on the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory fitted to the trailing edges, transitioning to a convex curve at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters (likely barnacle scars or spots) scattered across the white ventral surface. Dense, high-contrast calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the medial portion of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on the distal tips and sporadically along the trailing edge, causing significant localized geometric disruption of the edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water droplets shedding from the left lobe tip, creating vertical high-intensity streaks against the ocean background.
